title: First deploy: GitHub production environment and the M0 checks
caption: deploy/README.md 'First deploy (human steps of X-023)'.

steps.title: Create the production environment
steps.body: Required reviewer: yourself; deployment branches and tags: `main` and `v*`; secrets `DEPLOY_HOST`, `DEPLOY_USER` (`deploy`), `DEPLOY_SSH_KEY`, `DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS` (`ssh-keyscan -t ed25519 <host>` compared with `/etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub`).

steps.title: Run Deploy from main
steps.body: Choose `main`; wait for build and e2e; approve the deploy job.

steps.title: Check the ledgers
steps.body: `sudo -u postgres psql -d velexis -c "SELECT 'platform', id FROM platform.schema_migrations UNION ALL SELECT 'reference', id FROM reference.schema_migrations"`
steps.expect: `0001_baseline` in both, `R__ota_read_access` in platform; table owner `velexis_migrator`.

steps.title: Deploy the same commit again
steps.expect: `diff` prints nothing; log says `release <sha> is already on the VM` without `systemd units updated` or `Caddyfile reloaded`.
